People
move
to
a
new
region
for
many
different
reasons
.
The
motivation
for
moving
can
come
from
a
combination
of
what
researchers
sometimes
call
'
push
and
pull
factors
'
,
those
that
encourage
people
to
leave
a
region
,
and
those
that
attract
people
to
a
region
.
Some
of
the
factors
that
motivate
people
to
move
include
seeking
a
better
climate
,
finding
more
affordable
housing
,
looking
for
work
or
retiring
from
work
,
leaving
the
congestion
of
city
living
,
wanting
a
more
pleasant
environment
,
and
wanting
to
be
near
to
family
and
friends
.
In
reality
,
many
complex
factors
and
personal
reasons

to

or

to
move
